use crate::misc;
use crate::misc::gityas_myers::{DiffHunk, EditType};
use anyhow::Result;
use git2::Diff;
use gityas_domain::models::file::{
    ConflictChunk, ConflictType, GitYasConflict, GitYasDelta, GitYasDiff, GitYasHunk,
};
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ops::Deref;

pub fn get_commit_file_diff(
    repo: &git2::Repository,
    commit_id: Option<String>,
    gityas_delta: GitYasDelta,
) -> Result<GitYasDiff> {
    let commit = if let Some(commit_id) = commit_id.as_ref() {
        repo.find_commit(git2::Oid::from_str(commit_id)?)?
    } else {
        repo.head()?.peel_to_commit()?
    };

    let tree = commit.tree()?;
    let mut diff_opts = git2::DiffOptions::new();
    diff_opts.context_lines(3).pathspec(gityas_delta.file_path);

    let diff: Diff = match commit_id {
        Some(_) => {
            let parent_tree = if commit.parents().len() > 0 {
                commit.parent(0)?.tree()?
            } else {
                repo.find_tree(
                    git2::Oid::from_str("4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904").unwrap(),
                )?
            };

            repo.diff_tree_to_tree(Some(&parent_tree), Some(&tree), Some(&mut diff_opts))?
        }
        None => repo.diff_index_to_workdir(None, Some(&mut diff_opts))?,
    };

    // Process hunks for this file
    let mut hunks = Vec::new();
    let current_hunk = RefCell::new(None::<GitYasHunk>);
    // Get full file contents for old and new versions
    let old_content = if !gityas_delta.old_path.is_empty() {
        match commit_id.is_some() {
            true => get_file_content_at_commit(repo, &commit.parent(0)?, &gityas_delta.old_path)
                .unwrap_or_default(),
            false => get_file_content_at_commit(repo, &commit, &gityas_delta.old_path)
                .unwrap_or_default(),
        }
    } else {
        String::new()
    };
    let new_content = if !gityas_delta.new_path.is_empty() {
        match commit_id.is_some() {
            true => get_file_content_at_commit(repo, &commit, &gityas_delta.new_path)
                .unwrap_or_default(),
            false => get_file_content_at_workdir(repo, &gityas_delta.new_path).unwrap_or_default(),
        }
    } else {
        String::new()
    };

    diff.foreach(
        &mut |_, _| true,
        None,
        Some(&mut |_delta, hunk| {
            if let Some(hunk) = current_hunk.borrow_mut().take() {
                hunks.push(hunk);
            }

            // Start a new hunk
            *current_hunk.borrow_mut() = Some(GitYasHunk {
                old_start: hunk.old_start(),
                old_lines: hunk.old_lines(),
                new_start: hunk.new_start(),
                new_lines: hunk.new_lines(),
            });
            true
        }),
        None,
    )?;

    // Add the last hunk if it exists
    if current_hunk.borrow().deref().is_some() {
        let hunk = current_hunk.borrow().clone().unwrap();
        hunks.push(hunk);
    }

    // Create the styled diff for this file
    Ok(GitYasDiff {
        old_content,
        new_content,
        hunks,
    })
}

// Helper function to get file content at a specific commit
fn get_file_content_at_commit(
    repo: &git2::Repository,
    commit: &git2::Commit,
    path: &str,
) -> Result<String, git2::Error> {
    let tree = commit.tree()?;
    match tree.get_path(std::path::Path::new(path)) {
        Ok(entry) => {
            let blob = repo.find_blob(entry.id())?;
            let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(blob.content()).to_string();
            Ok(content)
        }
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

fn get_file_content_at_workdir(repo: &git2::Repository, path: &str) -> Result<String> {
    // Get the absolute path to the file
    let repo_workdir = repo.workdir().ok_or(git2::Error::from_str(
        "Not a standard repository with a working directory",
    ))?;
    let absolute_file_path = repo_workdir.join(path);
    // Read the file content directly from the filesystem
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(absolute_file_path)?;
    Ok(content)
}

pub fn get_merge_conflict_by_path(
    repo: &git2::Repository,
    path: &String,
) -> Result<GitYasConflict> {
    let mut index = repo.index()?;
    index.read(false)?;

    let conflict = index.conflict_get(std::path::Path::new(path))?;

    // Helper to load blob content as String
    let load = |entry: Option<git2::IndexEntry>| {
        if entry.is_none() {
            return String::default();
        }

        let blob = repo.find_blob(entry.unwrap().id);

        match blob {
            Ok(blob) => String::from_utf8_lossy(blob.content()).into_owned(),
            Err(_) => String::default(),
        }
    };

    let ance = load(conflict.ancestor).to_string();
    let oursstr = load(conflict.our).to_string();
    let theirsstr = load(conflict.their).to_string();

    let conflict = get_conflicts_by_files(ance, oursstr, theirsstr)?;
    Ok(conflict)
}

pub fn get_conflicts_by_files(ancestor: String, ours: String, theirs: String) -> Result<GitYasConflict> {
    let ours_diffs: Vec<DiffHunk> =
        misc::gityas_myers::myers_diff(ancestor.clone().as_str(), ours.clone().as_str())
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|c| c.edit_type != EditType::Equal)
            .collect();
    let theirs_diffs: Vec<DiffHunk> =
        misc::gityas_myers::myers_diff(ancestor.clone().as_str(), theirs.clone().as_str())
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|c| c.edit_type != EditType::Equal)
            .collect();

    let merged = misc::gityas_merger::merge_non_conflicting_chunks(
        ancestor.as_str(),
        ours.as_str(),
        theirs.as_str(),
        ours_diffs,
        theirs_diffs,
    );

    let conflict = GitYasConflict {
        ancestor: merged.merged_text,
        ours: ours,
        theirs: theirs,
        chunks: merged
            .conflicts
            .into_iter()
            .map(|chunk| {
                let (merged_ancestor_start, merged_ancestor_end) = chunk.merged_ancestor_range;
                let (ours_start, ours_end) = chunk.ours_range;
                let (theirs_start, theirs_end) = chunk.theirs_range;

                ConflictChunk {
                    conflict_type: ConflictType::Both,
                    ours_start: if ours_start == 0 {
                        ours_start
                    } else {
                        ours_start + 1
                    },
                    ours_end: if ours_start == ours_end && ours_end != 0 {
                        ours_start + 1
                    } else {
                        ours_end
                    },
                    theirs_start: if theirs_start == 0 {
                        theirs_start
                    } else {
                        theirs_start + 1
                    },
                    theirs_end: if theirs_start == theirs_end && theirs_end != 0 {
                        theirs_start + 1
                    } else {
                        theirs_end
                    },
                    ancestor_start: if merged_ancestor_start == 0 {
                        merged_ancestor_start
                    } else {
                        merged_ancestor_start + 1
                    },
                    ancestor_end: if merged_ancestor_start == merged_ancestor_end && merged_ancestor_end != 0 {
                        merged_ancestor_start + 1
                    } else {
                        merged_ancestor_end
                    },

                }
            })
            .collect(),
    };

    Ok(conflict)
}
